observed_harness_defect.description: The repository arXiv parse_atom helper returns SERVICE_ERROR for any entry whose title begins with 'Error'. In the first Dev-3 attempt, three candidate calls produced scientific-abstract notes under SERVICE_ERROR, opening false obligations despite otherwise valid returned entries.
observed_harness_defect.correction: Treat an Atom entry as an API error only when its entry/id is under arxiv.org/api/errors. Titles are never an error discriminator. Continue to admit only entry/id scorer identities.

frozen_unchanged_components: 24 development task IDs and task order
three requests per task per system
development eligibility rule: recall delta >= 0.01, IoU delta > 0, precision delta >= 0
validity_rule: All 72 calls for each system must be OK, zero open obligations, zero task closures, exact development task hash.
outcome_rule: If the harness-corrected Dev-3R is valid, apply the original frozen Dev-3 eligibility rule exactly once. If non-eligible, terminate acquisition widening. No Dev-4.
forbidden: changing acquisition/query/ranking behavior in the correction wrapper
changing development thresholds after the first Dev-3 partial metrics
creating Dev-4 if Dev-3R is valid and non-eligible
using invalid first-attempt Dev-3 metrics as confirmatory evidence
